unlisted_practices: Delphi-developed evaluation criteria for medical LLM chatbots covering professional, social, contextual capabilities and robustness

screen.reason: The study develops and applies a benchmark framework (MedGPTEval) with expert evaluations to assess hallucination, safety, and capabilities of multiple LLMs on medical dialogues and case reports, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
